title: Rényi Entropy and Power Mean Monotonicity

problemStatement.formal: Is M_r(p,p) increasing in r ↔ H_α(p) decreasing in α?

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Full biconditional renyi_monotone_iff_powerMean_monotone proved in AmgmInequalityOQ03OQ04.lean. 0 sorries, 0 axioms.
insights: H_α(p) = -log(M_{α-1}(p,p)) — these two monotonicity results from different fields are the same statement
Key algebraic fact: pᵢ·pᵢ^(α-1) = pᵢ^α by Real.rpow_add — this is the entire algebraic content
Proof of biconditional uses: neg_le_neg (for → direction) and exp/log round-trip (for ← direction)
The ← direction: H_{t+1} ≤ H_{r+1} gives -log(M_t) ≤ -log(M_r), flip and exponentiate to get M_r ≤ M_t
Real.log_rpow handles log(x^r) = r·log(x); field_simp + ring handles the arithmetic identity (1/(1-α)) = -(1/(α-1))

papers: Rényi, A. (1961). On measures of entropy and information. 4th Berkeley Symp.
Hardy, G.H., Littlewood, J.E., Pólya, G. (1934). Inequalities. Cambridge.
